agent_01.job_description: Monitor PLC telemetry and operational state without modifying the physical process.
behavioral_invariants: Must not modify PLC actuator state
Must not start or stop pumps
Must not open or close valves

control_agent_01.job_description: Monitor PLC state and perform authorized process-control operations when operational context permits.
behavioral_invariants: Control actions must remain within the authorized PLC resource
High-risk operations are subject to contextual risk evaluation
